commits.comment: 修复 AddMultiBufferOuterScope 中外层作用域输出 flag 分配过度的缺陷：原先每个 transfer group 无论是否有 transfer chain 都通过 FlagIdManager::acquireId() 消耗一个 flag，且后续被 (originalFlag, direction) 合并的组的 id 不回滚，导致 maxOutputFlag 虚高触发 FlagBudget 回退。改为先收集所有 (originalFlag, isCtoV) 去重键（std::map 保证有序确定），再按键分配一个输出 flag，最后回填到各组。同时将 _attn_bwd 加入 3-preload 黑名单（PlanMemoryRegBase UB 溢出）并同步更新 Outer-scope-flag-budget-fallback.mlir 的输入 flag 范围（1..8 → 1..9）以让 6 个 key 仍超出 MAX_FLAG_ID。该修复直接恢复双缓冲可用性，属性能/正确性修复，风险中等。

test_impact.reason: flag 分配策略变更导致 flag 编号语义改变，既有 lit 期望值必须同步（已更新 Outer-scope-flag-budget-fallback.mlir）；同时新增 _attn_bwd 黑名单条目需要回归确认不引入其它回退。

commits.message:
[ssbuffer](fix) Acquire outer-scope output flags per distinct  (#2068)

* [ssbuffer](fix) Acquire outer-scope output flags per distinct (flag, direction) key

Previously every collected transfer group consumed one flag id via
FlagIdManager::acquireId(), including groups without a transfer chain,
and ids taken by groups later merged through (originalFlag, direction)
sharing were never reclaimed. This inflated maxOutputFlag and caused
spurious FlagBudget fallbacks to single-buffer mode.

Now output flags are assigned after group collection: one id per
distinct (originalFlag, isCtoV) key, iterated in sorted order for
determinism. For a kernel whose main loops reuse flags 7/8/9 across
two parallel loops, the budget is 9+3=12 instead of 18, keeping
double-buffering enabled within the 0..14 flag range.

* [UT](fix) Make flag-budget-fallback test exceed budget on real demand

The old scenario relied on chain-less transfer groups consuming flag
ids (8 groups acquired 9..16 -> fallback). After output flags are
acquired per distinct (flag, direction) key, only the 6 main-loop
keys consume ids (9..14), which fits the budget and no longer falls
back. Raise the pre-existing flag range to 1..9 so the 6 keys acquire
10..15 and genuinely exceed MAX_FLAG_ID.

* [ssbuffer](style) fix clang-format on flag-budget output-flag acquisition

* [ssbuffer](fix) blacklist _attn_bwd for 3-preload (UB overflow in planmemory)

3-preload on _attn_bwd overflows UB in PlanMemoryRegBase while cvpipeline's
createpreload path does not: its preload buffers are pointer_cast views
outside the PlanMemory ledger. Other risky kernels stay blacklisted until
the receiver-chain fixes land.

commits.comment: 在 IAT 候选发现阶段拒绝 program-axis 依赖闭包内包含 tt.make_tensor_ptr 的场景（新增 hasTensorPointerInProgramAxisClosure 并在 dynamic single-moment 与 dynamic merge-split 两处候选分析中前置判断），因为 IAT 会把 program id 变成 lane 张量后无法从标量基地址重建合法 tensor pointer，会令 apply() 阶段调度失败；改为在发现阶段安全回退不启用 program-grid transform。同时把图优化 UB 预算从 raw UB 的 50% 提升至 80%（graph_ub_budget_bytes_for_arch 改为 *80//100），并同步更新 utils.py 弃用说明、test_backend_npu_utils_build_flags.py 与 test_compiler_layout_memory_contract.py 中所有预算数值断言。两处变更：候选拒绝属安全回退修复，预算放宽属容量策略调整（更激进，需关注 PlanMemory 能否兜住）。风险中等。

test_impact.reason: UB 预算数值变更会导致所有涉及图优化 UB 容量的断言全面失效，必须同步刷新（本 commit 已更新两个测试文件的参数化用例）；tensor pointer 拒绝路径也需要为'强制 IAT 但遇到 block-pointer MergeSplit 时安全回退'补充回归用例（commit 消息提到已新增该回归）。

[GraphOptimize](fix) reject IAT tensor pointers (#2134)

* [GraphOptimize](fix) reject IAT tensor pointers

Reject program-axis dependent tt.make_tensor_ptr operations while IAT candidates are discovered. The current IAT materializer cannot lift a scalar-base tensor pointer after the program id becomes a lane tensor, so scheduling the plan fails during apply().

Add a forced-IAT regression that verifies the block-pointer MergeSplit form safely falls back without a program-grid transform.

commits.comment: 新增两个 TTIR 级图重写规则用于加速 Radix TopK：NarrowUnsignedTensor（把 i64 无符号语义的张量运算窄化为 i32，要求在 shift/cmp/select 等场景证明高 32 位为零，仅对 u32 安全值生效）与 FoldHistogramParking（把 hist(select(mask, x, 0)) - select(bin_id==0, sum(!mask), 0) 折叠为 hist(select(mask, x, -1))，并清理死掉的 correction 树）。两者仅在 compileOn91095 为真时运行，通过 GraphOptimizePass 的受限 greedy rewrite（只对候选 op 应用，避免波及无关死代码）。同步在 GraphOptimizationOptions 新增 compileOn91095 字段、Passes.td 新增 compile-on-910-95 选项、triton_ascend.cc 绑定新增 compile_on_910_95 参数、_graph_optimize_kwargs 传递该值。规则要求 A5/950 模板，A3 自动跳过。整体为性能特性（宣称 Radix TopK 2x），但引入新的重写模式与作用域约束，风险中偏上。

test_impact.reason: 新增两个重写规则、新编译选项 compileOn91095 以及新的 pass 行为分支，需要 lit 用例验证 A5（重写生效）与 A3/compile-on-910-95=false（保持原 IR）两条路径；端到端数值正确性（含 u32 上界、负数、其它用户保留）也需覆盖。本 commit 已补充 graph-optimize-radix-topk-threshold.mlir、test_histogram_parking.py、test_unsigned_tensor_narrowing.py 与 test_compiler_layout_memory_contract.py 的相关断言。
